spots.name: Brewery Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 430 m (1,411 ft).

spots.name: Lake Babcock
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Lake Babcock: Boy Scout Island on the shore.
